title: Career Mentoring Programme
description: Per accompagnare gli studenti verso il mondo del lavoro, l’USI Career and Alumni Service offre agli studenti di Master un programma di Career Mentoring che mette in contatto studenti e alumni USI con esperienza.

blocks.html:
To support students in their transition into the world of work, the USI Career and Alumni Service offers Master’s students a Career Mentoring programme that connects students with experienced USI alumni.

Active programmes:

  • USI Alumni in Digital Fashion Communication Career Mentoring
    Dedicated to students officially enrolled in the Master in Digital Fashion Communication.
  • USI Alumni in Finance Career Mentoring
    Dedicated to students officially enrolled in the Master in Finance.

Objective:

To provide USI Master’s students with personalised support from an alumnus/alumna Mentor, helping them take their first steps into the professional world through practical advice, insights into the job market, and the sharing of experiences gained in their field after graduating from USI.

Next edition:

Both programmes will run during the 2026/2027 academic year.

How to participate:

Interested students can consult the dedicated pages for deadlines, eligibility requirements, and guidelines.

Testimonials:

Here are some testimonials from the 2024/2025 edition USI Alumni in Finance Career Mentoring:

blocks.name: Nicolò de Nart
blocks.html:
Mentor Edition 2024/2025

USI Degree: Master in Finance, 2022

I found most useful the confrontation with the mentee, as well as giving him advice and revisiting in him situations that I myself have gone through.

blocks.name: Eleonora Ferrario
blocks.html:
Mentee Edition 2024/2025

Participating in the programme was a truly valuable experience. Having a mentor who graduated from the same program just a few years ago allowed me to receive advice that was both relevant and directly applicable to my current stage. He had recently faced the same challenges I am about to face, which gave him a unique perspective and allowed him to offer guidance that felt authentic and realistic. Our discussions covered career paths, job search strategies, CV optimization, networking, and more. I left each session feeling more confident and better prepared for what lies ahead.
